title: State relabelling preserves space use
statement: Let $M$ be a multi-tape Turing machine with $k$ work tapes, let $e$ be a bijection from its state set to another state set, let $x$ be an input word, and let $t\in\mathbb{N}$. The total number of distinct work-tape cells visited from the initial configuration on $x$ through step $t$ is the same for $M$ and the machine obtained by relabelling its states along $e$.
hypotheses_covered: A multi-tape Turing machine with $k$ work tapes
A bijection between its state set and another state set
